description: For every algebraically closed field F of characteristic 0, every integer k≥2, and every non‑zero polynomial n∈F[x], any set A⊂F[x] satisfying that ab+n is a k‑th power for all distinct a,b∈A must have size at most 6, except when n is a perfect k‑th power and A is contained in the principal ideal generated by a k‑th root of n.
proof_strategy: Generalize the determinant criterion and Mason–Stothers theorem to bound the cardinality of D_k(n) tuples, and apply the Combinatorial Nullstellensatz to rule out larger configurations.
title: Conjecture on Absolute Boundedness of Polynomial Diophantine Tuples

description: For all n, k ∈ ℕ, the number of intervals [x,y] in the greedy 1‑Tamari poset on Dyck_n such that the lower endpoint x has exactly k valleys equals the number of bipartite planar maps with n+1 edges and exactly k black vertices.
proof_strategy: Use the recursive decomposition of greedy Tamari intervals into sum and product operations given in the paper and show that it matches the decomposition of bipartite planar maps by inserting a black vertex. This yields a size‑ and valley‑preserving bijection, which can be formalized by induction on n.
title: Refined enumeration of greedy Tamari intervals by valley count equals refined enumeration of bipartite planar maps by black vertex count

description: Investigate the sequence "Orderly" Friedman numbers (or "good" or "nice" Friedman numbers): Friedman numbers (A036057) where the construction digits are used in the proper order. with terms 127,343,736,1285,2187,2502,2592,2737,3125,3685,3864,3972,4096,6455,11264,11664,12850,13825,14641,155. Find a closed form, recurrence, or asymptotic and formalize it in Lean 4.
title: OEIS sequence: "Orderly" Friedman numbers (or "good" or "nice" Friedman numbers): Friedman numbers (A036057) where the construction digits are used in the proper order.

description: Investigate the sequence Maximal number of "good" manifolds in an n-nice polytope. with terms 6,8,12,24,40,80,128,256,512,1024,2048,4096,8192,16384,32768,65536,131072,262144,524288,1048576,20971. Find a closed form, recurrence, or asymptotic and formalize it in Lean 4.
title: OEIS sequence: Maximal number of "good" manifolds in an n-nice polytope.
